name: Osteochondroma
definition: Cartilage-capped bony exostosis arising near a growth plate, usually benign and often discovered in adolescence.

investigations.principle: Radiographs usually diagnose; MRI evaluates cartilage cap and neurovascular compression.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Excision is considered for pain, function compromise or malignant concern.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi-vriddhi phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Cartilage-capped bony exostosis arising near a growth plate, usually benign and often discovered in adolescence.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
